description: This file contains source code for handling Git notes operations, including creating commits for notes, parsing merge strategies, configuring notes rewriting, and copying notes within a Git repository.

methods.name: void create_notes_commit(struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const struct commit_list * parents,const char * msg,size_t msg_len,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Creates a commit object for notes, handling references and parent commits.

methods.name: void commit_notes(struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const char * msg)
methods.description: Creates and commits a notes tree with the specified message.

methods.name: int parse_notes_merge_strategy(const char * v,enum notes_merge_strategy * s)
methods.description: Parses a string into a notes merge strategy enum.

methods.name: combine_notes_fn parse_combine_notes_fn(const char * v)
methods.description: Parses a string into a function pointer for combining notes.

methods.name: int notes_rewrite_config(const char * k,const char * v,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures notes rewriting based on Git config entries.

methods.name: struct:notes_rewrite_cfg * init_copy_notes_for_rewrite(const char * cmd)
methods.description: Initializes notes rewrite configuration based on environment variables and config.

methods.name: int copy_note_for_rewrite(struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const struct object_id * from_obj,const struct object_id * to_obj)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object ID to another using the rewrite configuration.

methods.name: void finish_copy_notes_for_rewrite(struct repository * r,struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const char * msg)
methods.description: Finalizes the notes copy process, creating commits and cleaning up resources.
